summary: Verified iteration 266 deep-link 404 fix. All 4 new Navigate routes (/portfolio, /kanban, /list, /community) redirect logged-in users to /dashboard?view=X and the corresponding Dashboard view renders — no NotFound page shown. Public /portfolio/:userId still renders PublicPortfolio component (confirmed 'Portfolio Not Found — User not found' error state for invalid id, no redirect to /dashboard). Regression checks on /login, /, /dashboard all pass. Unauthenticated /kanban visit does not crash or blank.
critical_code_review_comments: Non-blocking (pre-existing, not caused by this fix): CommunityFeed.tsx triggers React 'Invalid hook call' errors when the /community view mounts (dashboard now shows this view after the fix). Likely a duplicate React copy issue with an icon library (ImageSquareIcon in @phosphor-icons/react). Recommend inspecting CommunityFeed imports and Vite deps optimization to avoid double-bundled React.
Non-blocking (pre-existing): Dashboard analytics widget produces SVG 'MNaN,24' path errors when data is empty — data validation missing before feeding into <path d>.
Non-blocking: HMR WebSocket 429 rate-limit noise in preview environment during rapid navigation — expected in preview; ignore.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 266 fix verified working end-to-end via UI. Deep link redirects use react-router <Navigate to="/dashboard?view=X" replace/> before the /portfolio/:userId dynamic route so the static routes take precedence — order in App.tsx (lines 94–98) is correct. PublicPortfolio still resolves for /portfolio/:userId. Note: CommunityFeed has a pre-existing React hook error unrelated to the routing fix but now newly reachable via /community deep-link — flag to main agent as separate followup, not a regression from this fix.
rca of the issue: N/A — this was a fix verification run. Original bug was that direct visits to /portfolio, /kanban, /list, /community fell through to the catch-all NotFound route because Dashboard only recognized ?view= query params, not path segments. Fix inserted 4 <Route path='/X' element={<Navigate to='/dashboard?view=X' replace/>}/> entries before the /portfolio/:userId dynamic route in App.tsx. Confirmed working.
